icon-button.$description: IconButton's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--icon-button-<name>) on the page, a container or one button, and every one inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

radius-round.$description: The corners of a round icon button (shape="round").
